description: Source code defining classes and functions for object detection segmentation models, including mask prediction, attention mechanisms, and post-processing for panoptic segmentation.

classes.name: DETRsegm
classes.description: Convolutional head for mask prediction and segmentation in object detection models.

classes.name: MaskHeadSmallConv
classes.description: A small convolutional neural network head for mask upsampling using group normalization.

classes.name: MHAttentionMap
classes.description: A 2D multi-head attention module that computes attention weights.

classes.name: PostProcessSegm
classes.description: Post-processing module to convert model outputs into segmentation masks.

classes.name: PostProcessPanoptic
classes.description: Converts model outputs into panoptic segmentation format compatible with COCO API.

methods.name: _expand
methods.description: Utility function to expand a tensor along a new dimension for broadcasting.

methods.name: dice_loss
methods.description: Computes the DICE loss for mask predictions.

methods.name: sigmoid_focal_loss
methods.description: Computes the focal loss used in dense object detection models like RetinaNet.
